commit_message:
[Merged] Fix a crash that could occur if the destination database of a backup is replaced using sqlite3_deserialize() between the call to sqlite3_backup_init() and the first call to sqlite3_backup_step(). Forum post [forum:15d82885e2 | 15d82885e2].

FossilOrigin-Name: 1f940357f7bb160b583ac5b08ff4e32a9fef353255d032c5a18bcb04416c0f0b
pr_title: Keep backup database references valid across database replacement and ATTACH
pr_description:
Resolve backup source and destination B-trees through connection handles and database indexes so backups use the current database after sqlite3_deserialize() and remain valid when ATTACH reallocates the database array. Update backup operations and VACUUM's internal copy interface to use these indexes.

Validation: the resulting diff applies cleanly against the base commit.

intro_commit_message:
Fix a crash that could occur if the destination database of a backup is replaced using sqlite3_deserialize() between the call to sqlite3_backup_init() and the first call to sqlite3_backup_step(). Forum post [forum:15d82885e2 | 15d82885e2].

FossilOrigin-Name: 1f940357f7bb160b583ac5b08ff4e32a9fef353255d032c5a18bcb04416c0f0b
fix_commit_message:
Avoid a use-after-free problem that could occur if ATTACH statements are executed while a backup operation is active. Bug [bugs:/info/2026-06-23T15:46:48Z | 2026-06-23T15:46:48Z].

FossilOrigin-Name: 9454592878b5732d37d61f4541bd6f0c1f893c20fc833ce4c600f9470e62d6f2
agent_reasoning: Caching Db pointers retains addresses inside the dynamically allocated aDb array. ATTACH can reallocate that array, leaving an active backup with dangling pointers and causing use-after-free. The updated code stores database indexes and resolves B-trees through the current connection array, preserving support for destination replacement by sqlite3_deserialize(). VACUUM supplies the connection and indexes to its internal backup object. Only the three source files were edited; test files and git history were not modified.
